title: Best Trash Can (2026)
summary: We're still testing and researching this guide. Picks will be added soon.
method: Picks were made by comparing products mentioned in Consumer Reports, PCMag, CNET, Reviewed, TechGearLab, and Bon Appétit. Products that appeared in more than one source were prioritized.
assumptions: Prices are omitted because none of the sources provide a consistent price for each model.
